value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor looks hot and sunny. It may start with a chance of a shower, maybe a thunderstorm, then clear up in the morning. The afternoon should be around 29°C, feeling like 35 with the humidex. The wind picks up from mid-afternoon into the evening, west at about 30 km/h with gusts to 50. The UV index is high, at 6.
